text:
Emma: FYI I just noticed Quicklinks on org:acme showing metrics from org:zephyr after the canary. Not great.
Raj: Ugh. Which panel and timeline? repro steps?
Emma: Steps to reproduce: open left sidebar -> Quicklinks -> click a saved filter -> rapidly switch org (top-right) -> metrics update but counts look like the previous org. Happened twice.
Emma: Paste of a request that matched the wrong cache key: ```GET /api/panels/quicklink?id=311&since=1h Host: console.internal x-org-id: 123 x-user-id: emma x-prefetch-key: user:emma:snapshot:x y-cache-key: quicklink:311:hash:abcd```
Lisa: That header combo screams cache key normalization bug — looks like `y-cache-key` is generated from `x-user-id` not `x-org-id` in the prefetch worker. If prefetch is populated before org switch we can serve stale org-specific payloads.
Kai: I bet the router / prefetch flow is using ephemeral user namespace for the LRU key. We should require tenant-scoped prefix in cache keys (e.g., `tenant:<org-id>:...`).
Raj: Is this limited to Quicklinks or other panels? Emma: I saw it once on insights panel and once on the sidebar quicklink dropdown. Might be broader.
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout for `console-prefetch-v2` at commit `c3f2a9` detected; rolling back to `b8a1f0` as of 2024-05-03T14:12:03Z.
Morgan: Thanks deploy-bot — rollback started. Immediate mitigation: disable `console.prefetch.enabled` via FF for the canary cohort and bump canary to 0%.
Kai: Agreed. I'll open a PR to: 1) change cache key generation to include `org_id` 2) add a guard that rejects serving a cached payload if `payload.org_id != request.org_id`. PR link when ready.
Lisa: Also add an integration test that does `rapid-org-swap` across multiple concurrent requests — I can add that to the harness.
Raj: We should add a telemetry signal: `panel.tenant_mismatch` whenever a served payload's org_id != request org_id. Alert if >0.1% of requests in 5m.
Emma: Can someone run a historical scan for potential exposure window? Query suggestion: ```select count(*) as mismatches, min(ts), max(ts) from events where event_type='panel_render' and payload_org_id != req_org_id and ts > now() - interval '7 days';```
Morgan: I'll run a sampling job against prod-logs and post numbers here. If any PII surfaced we need to kick legal/compliance.
Kai: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pulls/8123 — change set + unit tests.
Raj: After PR lands: canary -> small cohort with prefetch disabled, then re-enable with tenant-keying enforced and telemetry on. Rollout plan in PR description please.
Emma: I'll own the follow-up postmortem + customer outreach if we see exposed rows. Assigning owners: Kai (fix & tests), Lisa (integration tests + harness), Morgan (logs scan + telemetry), Raj (rollout guard + FF), Emma (postmortem + comms).
Lisa: Quicknote — check the quota middleware too. If quota keys are tied to user-only keys that could double-bill or misattribute usage.
Raj: Good call. Add `quota.tenant_scope` validation to the middleware as well.
Emma: Thanks all. Please tag me once PR is merged and when the log scan completes.
Morgan: Scan started, ETA ~20m. Will post results. :hourglass:
Kai: PR opened and marked urgent. Will follow up with code snippet in PR for cache key change.
Emma: Appreciate the quick responses. We'll track this as an incident until telemetry is green.
